description: Decode JWT header and payload claims locally without verifying the signature. The response always marks verification as false. Price: 5 sats per call.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 5 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

token.description: JWT compact serialization, up to 20 KB.
